title: SAT Pacing: How to Finish Every Module
description:
Running out of time on the SAT usually isn't about being slow. It's about one hard question eating the clock. This video gives you a pacing plan for every module of the digital SAT.

You'll learn:
• Time per question: about 71 seconds in Reading and Writing, about 95 in Math
• How College Board orders the questions in each module, and why it changes your pacing
• The two-pass method and when to mark a question for review and move on
• When Desmos saves time and when it wastes it
• What to do in the last two minutes (there's no penalty for guessing)
• A half-module pacing drill using the free SAT Suite Question Bank

Any example questions shown are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank and the full-length practice tests in Bluebook.
